backend/main.mo: Main Motoko actor defining cricket match data types (Match, Innings, Ball, Team, Player, Stats), user profiles, saved teams, and CRUD functions with access control integration for managing matches, player statistics, and team data.
feature_evidence.json: Feature evidence report documenting three implemented features: undo last ball functionality, live scoring state preservation across navigation, and over-by-over breakdown display, all with high confidence and mapped test IDs.
frontend-file-summaries.txt: Comprehensive summaries of all frontend source files describing component responsibilities, state management patterns, offline support, navigation flows, and UI behaviors across the React application.
frontend/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom OKLCH color system for light and dark themes, defining CSS variables for UI colors, borders, charts, and sidebar components.
frontend/index.html: HTML entry point for the QuickCricket Scorer app with viewport meta tag and module script loading the React application from main.tsx.
frontend/src/App.tsx: Root React component configuring TanStack Router with routes for dashboard, match setup, live scoring, summaries, stats, teams, and player stats, wrapped in QueryClient, ThemeProvider, and error boundary.
frontend/src/components/AppErrorBoundary: React error boundary component that catches and displays application errors with a user-friendly card UI and reset button to return to dashboard.
frontend/src/components/AppHeader.tsx: Application header component with navigation buttons (Home, Teams, Player Stats), Internet Identity login/logout with comprehensive error handling and timeout detection, and connectivity status display.
frontend/src/components/AppLayout.tsx: Main layout component that wraps the app with a header, main content area, and footer containing a caffeine.ai attribution link.
frontend/src/components/BackendCanisterI: Dialog component that explains what backend canisters are, how offline mode works, and what "Backend unavailable" means to users.
frontend/src/components/ConnectivityStat: Displays a badge showing online/offline status with specific reasons (network down or backend unavailable) and includes an info dialog.
frontend/src/components/DeleteMatchConfi: Confirmation dialog for deleting matches that warns users about local and backend deletion based on sync status and connectivity.
frontend/src/components/live/BatterRoleS: Reusable select component for choosing a batter from a list of players with error handling and disabled states.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBatterD: Dialog for selecting the next batter after a wicket, with special handling for all-out scenarios when no batters remain.
frontend/src/components/live/NextBowlerD: Dialog for selecting the next bowler at the end of an over, requiring a selection before continuing.
frontend/src/components/live/OverByOverB: Card component that displays a scrollable grid showing runs scored in each over of the innings.
frontend/src/components/mobile/MobileSaf: Wrapper for DialogContent that ensures proper mobile viewport handling with constrained height and scrolling.
Wrapper for SelectContent that limits height to 60vh for better mobile usability with scrollable overflow.
frontend/src/components/ProfileSetup.tsx: Modal dialog that prompts new users to enter their name to create a profile before using the app.
frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts: React Query hook that manages the backend actor instance, creating authenticated or anonymous actors based on Internet Identity and invalidating dependent queries on identity changes.
frontend/src/hooks/useConnectivity.ts: Hook that monitors device network status and backend availability by periodically probing the backend API, returning online/offline state with specific reasons (network-down or backend-unavailable).
frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.t: React context provider and hook for Internet Identity authentication, managing login/logout flow, identity persistence, and authentication status with support for delegation identity validation.
frontend/src/hooks/useLocalMatchIntegrit: Hook that checks local match storage integrity by validating stored matches, returning counts of total/loadable matches and a list of corrupted match IDs with retry capability.
frontend/src/hooks/useQueries.ts: React Query hooks for managing user profiles, matches, and ball recording with offline-first support, automatically falling back to local storage when offline or unauthenticated.
frontend/src/hooks/useScrollIntoViewOnFo: Hook that automatically scrolls an element into view when it receives focus, with a delay to accommodate mobile keyboard appearance.
frontend/src/hooks/useUnsavedOfflineChan: Hook that warns users before leaving a page with unsynced offline changes by intercepting beforeunload events and providing a navigation confirmation function.
frontend/src/index.css: Tailwind CSS configuration with custom CSS variables for light/dark theme colors, mobile-optimized touch targets, and overflow prevention for responsive layout.
frontend/src/main.tsx: Application entry point that sets up React Query client and Internet Identity provider, then renders the root App component.
frontend/src/offline/localMatchStore.ts: Local storage manager for cricket matches with functions to save, load, delete matches and record balls locally, including integrity checking and undo functionality with innings completion validation.
Provides structured error logging and user-facing error messages for offline operations like saving/loading matches, innings, and balls, with specific handling for storage quota and corruption errors.
frontend/src/offline/playerStatsStore.ts: Manages localStorage caching of cumulative player statistics with functions to load, save, retrieve individual player stats, and clear the cache.
frontend/src/offline/serialization.ts: Handles BigInt-safe JSON serialization and deserialization of Match, Innings, Ball, Team, and Player types for browser storage, converting BigInt fields to strings and back.
frontend/src/offline/teamRosterStore.ts: Manages localStorage persistence of saved team rosters with CRUD operations (load, save, update, delete) and BigInt serialization for team and player IDs.
frontend/src/pages/InningsSummaryPage.ts: Displays innings summary with batting and bowling statistics tables, calculates player performance metrics from ball-by-ball data, and provides navigation to start next innings or view match stats.
frontend/src/pages/LiveScoringPage.tsx: Main live scoring interface for recording balls with striker/non-striker/bowler selection, extras handling, undo functionality, and offline-first state management with local match storage.
Main dashboard listing all matches with status badges, delete functionality, and integrity checks for local storage. Provides navigation to create new matches or view existing ones.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSetupPage.tsx: Page for creating a new match with team selection, player rosters, overs configuration, and toss details. Supports loading saved teams and creating matches locally or on-chain depending on authentication status.
frontend/src/pages/MatchStatsPage.tsx: Displays detailed batting and bowling statistics for each innings of a match, loading data from local storage and presenting it in tabbed tables with metrics like runs, balls, strike rate, and economy.
frontend/src/pages/MatchSummaryPage.tsx: Shows a complete match summary after both innings are finished, including team scores, chase targets, match result, and innings-by-innings statistics with navigation back to dashboard.
frontend/src/pages/PlayerStatsPage.tsx: Displays cumulative player statistics across all matches, allowing team and player selection to view batting (runs, average, strike rate) and bowling (wickets, economy, average) performance metrics.
frontend/src/pages/TeamsPlayersPage.tsx: React page component for managing saved team rosters with CRUD operations (create, edit, delete) and navigation back to home, using local storage via teamRosterStore.
frontend/src/utils/backendAuthErrors.ts: Utility functions to detect and normalize backend authorization errors into user-friendly messages, specifically handling match creation permission errors.
frontend/src/utils/chase.ts: Cricket chase calculation utilities including target computation, remaining runs, wickets remaining, chase achievement status, and match result sentence generation.
frontend/src/utils/cumulativePlayerStats: Computes cumulative batting and bowling statistics across multiple matches for all players, with conversion functions to backend format for syncing.
frontend/src/utils/ensureMatchInitialize: Ensures a match has at least one innings initialized based on toss decision, creating the first innings with batting and bowling teams if none exist.
frontend/src/utils/formatTossInfo.ts: Formats match toss information into a human-readable sentence indicating which team won and their decision to bat or bowl.
frontend/src/utils/inningsCompletion.ts: Utilities for tracking innings completion by counting legal deliveries, checking overs limits, and computing current overs and balls.
frontend/src/utils/inningsEligibility.ts: Determines eligible batters for selection by filtering out players who are already out and optionally excluding specific players like current batters.
frontend/src/utils/lastOver.ts: Computes a view model for the last over bowled, selecting the last 6 legal deliveries with their display tokens (runs, wickets, extras) and total runs.
frontend/src/utils/matchStats.ts: Computes detailed batting statistics (runs, balls, strike rate, boundaries) and bowling statistics (overs, wickets, economy, extras) for all players in an innings.
frontend/src/utils/overByOverBreakdown.t: Computes over-by-over runs breakdown from ball history, returning only fully completed overs (6 legal deliveries each).
frontend/src/utils/parseMatchId.ts: Parses and validates match ID strings into bigint values, returning success/error result types.
frontend/src/utils/urlParams.ts: Provides utilities for extracting URL parameters from both query strings and hash-based routing, with sessionStorage persistence support for maintaining state across navigation.
frontend/tailwind.config.js: Tailwind CSS configuration defining custom color system using OKLCH, container settings, border radius variables, animations, and plugins for typography, container queries, and animations.
project_state.json: Project state tracking document listing architectural notes, existing features, and known issues including offline mode failures, missing extras handling, auto-populated batting selection, and incomplete innings completion logic.
